affected_system: privacy-preserving infectious-disease surveillance and response operations
alternatives: screen feasible locations against the largest access gaps for temporary infectious-disease service locations
co-optimize distributed and high-capacity locations for temporary infectious-disease service locations
pair capacitated access and infection-control facility siting with an explicit stop, review, and escalation rule
assumptions: Case, syndrome, testing, wastewater, vaccination, and care records have explicit definitions and delays.
No individual identity or protected health information enters public release artifacts.
All alternatives, capacities, costs, effects, thresholds, and failure scenarios are proposed until bound to evidence.
baseline: retain only existing approved locations for temporary infectious-disease service locations.

constraints.description: The infectious-disease public-health operations site must respect declared land control, accessibility, permitting, safety, and operating feasibility.
Every released metric must retain evidence type, source lineage, geography, time, assumptions, and uncertainty.
No analytical output may bypass lawful authority, accountable human review, or an applicable appeal process.

decision_cadence: recompiled at each planning cycle and after material evidence change
decision_owner: communicable-disease director and public-health operations chief
decision_question: Where should temporary health access points operate under demand, equity, cold-chain, and infection-control constraints?

independence_key.binding_constraint: The infectious-disease public-health operations site must respect declared land control, accessibility, permitting, safety, and operating feasibility.
independence_key.evidence_gate: Evidence for temporary infectious-disease service locations passes documented checks for parcel control, legal authority, environmental review, access, capacity, and operator responsibility.
independence_key.intervention_mechanism: capacitated access and infection-control facility siting
independence_key.primary_outcome: eligible population beyond timely qualified service access

intended_claim: A versioned site design for comparing declared alternatives affecting temporary infectious-disease service locations, conditional on its evidence gate.
limitations: This library record has no city binding and therefore reports no local input, output, or recommendation.
Readiness describes explicit source and method gates; it does not certify implementation feasibility.
External domain, legal, community, security, and operational review remains outside this design artifact.

objectives.metric: eligible population beyond timely qualified service access
distributional gap in eligible population beyond timely qualified service access
decision claims with complete evidence lineage

prohibited_claims: Do not call a candidate site clinically qualified, staffed, supplied, or publicly accepted.
Do not describe a design-only record as a city execution, deployment, adopted policy, or impact result.
Do not relabel proposed, estimated, simulated, optimized, or causal evidence as observed evidence.
Do not infer individual behavior, protected status, harm, or entitlement from aggregate records.

release_gate.failure_release: Release an explicit insufficient-evidence record naming missing sources, failed diagnostics, prohibited claims, and the next validation action.
release_gate.pass_condition: Evidence for temporary infectious-disease service locations passes documented checks for parcel control, legal authority, environmental review, access, capacity, and operator responsibility.

title: Site accessible testing, vaccination, and treatment access points
transportability_risks: Pathogens, immunity, clinical practice, reporting, testing, and public behavior differ.
Surveillance changes can mimic epidemiological changes.
